fields.label: Title
fields.description: Human-readable label — e.g. "Kapkolia Boundary" or "Patrol Zone 3". Not required; falls back to the record name.

fields.label: Geometry Type
fields.options:
Point
LineString
Polygon
MultiPoint
MultiLineString
MultiPolygon
fields.description: Derived automatically from the geometry on save — not set by hand.

fields.label: Farm
fields.description: Which farm this feature belongs to, if any. Independent of Reference Doctype/Name below — a patrol zone owned by Upande Security can still be tagged to a farm here for cross-module filtering.

fields.label: Reference Doctype
fields.description: The record this geometry actually belongs to — e.g. Farm, or a Security patrol block. Optional: a feature can exist with no specific owning record.

fields.label: Feature Role
fields.description: What this geometry represents for the referenced record - e.g. Location, Footprint, Alignment, Boundary, Access Road. Lets one record (a Farm, an Asset, ...) have more than one spatial feature at once (e.g. a boundary polygon AND a gate point), each distinguished by role rather than overwriting each other. Free text on purpose - the vocabulary is domain-specific and keeps growing; Spatial Entity Config can restrict it per doctype without needing a doctype migration every time a new role shows up.

fields.label: Source Module
fields.description: Which app/module created this feature — e.g. "Upande Security". Free text, set by the creating module's API call, purely for provenance/filtering.

fields.label: Layer
fields.description: Map layer this feature belongs to — auto-populated on upsert from the matching Spatial Entity Allowed Geometry row's Layer Name (matched on reference_doctype + geometry_type + feature_role), falling back to the reference doctype name or "Uncategorized". Not set by hand.

fields.label: Area (sq. m)
fields.description: Auto-computed on save for Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry using an equirectangular approximation centered on the feature — accurate for farm-sized areas, not meant for continental-scale geometry.

fields.label: Length (m)
fields.description: Auto-computed on save for LineString/MultiLineString geometry (sum of haversine segment distances).

fields.label: Properties (JSON)
fields.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata specific to the source module — e.g. block name, crop type, category — without needing a schema change here for every new consumer.
